name: ultrasound-clinic
description: Ultrasound Clinic Management System - convenience scripts for the web and backend packages

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
